scope: Current confirmed22 baseline at audit read; parent candidate changes not yet reviewed. No source edits or blind readers.
shared_means: Preview 6:20–6:28, real active-cyanide bottle on open support; rear closure split concealed from front. Staff keys also open later cupboard. Prepared bare crest glass set at 6:32, collected 7:04, poured in kitchen 7:06, served 7:09. Shared punch/food clean. Similar paper is not unique torn-edge match.
limits: All routes have an independent falsehood refutation, but falsehood is concealment evidence rather than mathematical proof of poison transfer. Some noncollection routes introduce precise preview access only in confession. E3 refers to historical post-final-evidence/pre-Method checkpoint, not the Opportunity round.

characters.name: Artie Ficial
characters.actual_motive: Removal from directorship and humiliation/control despite refusing donation.
characters.preview_poison_means: Director approved closed preview and routed bottle paperwork.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Waited at Grant place, straightened chair.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Intake removed the bottle before guests entered; only label remained.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: original_source: wide_preview shows physical original on open support.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Refusal already filed may feel like motive solved. Keep career/reputation consequences alive; add ordinary innocent private paperwork access.

exact_source.motive_murderer: Please, sit wherever you can hear. Grant wanted his name over the door, a vote in every department, and my resignation. Monet needed his check for wages; Sue objected to the terms. Six years here, and tonight I was supposed to introduce my own replacement. Grant expected me to call him our savior. I had practiced the introduction. I could not get through it.
exact_source.where_murderer: Sue and I stopped the announcement at the public desk. I sent my refusal to the board and told intake to keep the bottle out of the public exhibition. Then Grant wanted to see me privately. I went to his place. A glass, an empty chair. He could summon me and then leave me waiting. I straightened his chair before I left. There. That's how well I was handling it. Still tidying up after him. Claire, I kept smiling because I couldn't think what else a host was supposed to do.
exact_source.method_murderer: Intake removed the bottle from the support before the guests entered. Its label stayed. I refused the donation and sent that refusal to the board. There are decisions I will answer for. Allowing guests near a filled bottle was not one of them. Could someone else please deal with the tables? I cannot keep welcoming people into this room.
exact_source.where_innocent: Sue and I stopped the announcement at the public desk. I left my refusal in the coordinator's folder and sent it to the board office. I told intake to keep the bottle out of the public exhibition. Then I went on being the host. Smiled. Offered introductions. Claire, you kept looking at me as though you knew how close I was to losing my temper.

characters.name: Claire O’Scuro
characters.actual_motive: Grant holds earlier signed ownership approval against her.
characters.preview_poison_means: Controls intake, moved bottle papers, approved preview.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Delivered copy beside glass and moved glass off paper.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: The intake sheet says empty.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: original_source intake explicitly says inert liquid; collection_working_proof retains original-contents query.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Empty versus inert is clear but subtle in speech; repeat document title, not technical file IDs.

exact_source.motive_murderer: The bowl's ownership papers were incomplete. I approved its label too soon; Grant retained my signature. Reed kept asking me to revisit it. Grant could expose the earlier approval whenever I objected to his claim. My department was meant to thank him tonight. Instead I was trying to withdraw authority he already possessed, with my student watching.
exact_source.where_murderer: I removed the bowl's ownership label; Reed kept the old wording. The bottle's papers went to intake because approval was on hold. Grant wanted the explanation brought to him personally. I put his copy beside the glass at his place. He was elsewhere. I remember moving the glass to keep its damp base off the paper. Such a small, fussy thing to remember. Reed, I was angry enough to let him wait for his explanation afterward.
exact_source.method_murderer: The intake sheet says empty. I authorized an empty historical bottle for the preview. I moved its papers as part of catalog work. I did not approve a filled vessel. Reed, you may dislike how I handled the bowl. You would be right to. Please keep that failure separate from something I never authorized.
exact_source.where_innocent: I removed the bowl's ownership label. The bowl remained. Reed kept the old wording. I moved the bottle's incoming papers from the public display file to intake because its approval was on hold. Both files were on that desk. Reed, please stop calling everything I did a correction. Some of it was simply putting an unpleasant decision where I would not have to look at it.

characters.name: Monet Bags
characters.actual_motive: Restricted payroll transfer exposed by proposed donor audit.
characters.preview_poison_means: Accounts staff access; preview extraction asserted only at confession.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Unsigned-bill visit at bare glass.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: I looked for Grant before the preview; his glass was set out, unwrapped.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: service_account setup 6:32 follows original_source preview 6:20–6:28.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Claim is already refutable when delivered because service account is earlier. Keep false-before; after-preview destroys discriminant. Repeat the two printed times visibly.

exact_source.motive_murderer: Friday. That's when wages are due. My mother used to wait by the phone on payday. I know what that does to a household. I'd moved money to pay our staff. Grant wanted the books before releasing his check, and the board wanted answers too. Artie hated losing authority. I had transfers to explain and no time left to explain them.
exact_source.where_murderer: The manager brought the cheese ticket to accounts. I crossed out our account and sent the donor copy back. The restricted-fund transfer was still off the board's agenda. Grant wanted my books before releasing his donation. I went to his private place to get a signature; his glass was waiting, he wasn't. I stayed with the unsigned bill for a bit. Brie, whose money did he think kept appearing whenever he asked for something? Mine? Yours?
exact_source.method_murderer: I looked for Grant before the preview. His glass was set out, unwrapped, beside the invoice. He wasn't there. I left his copy for signing and returned to accounts. The cheese argument continued later. So did payroll. Artie, don't tell them we all agreed. We didn't. I was the one expected to find the money.
exact_source.where_innocent: The manager brought the extra-course ticket to accounts. I crossed out our account and sent the donor copy back with the manager. Grant could sign for his cheese. I'd already moved restricted money into payroll without telling the board. Brie, I know the supplier wants paying. So do the cleaners. I had run out of people I could ask to wait.

characters.name: Chip Patina
characters.actual_motive: Grant has insurance sheet with altered treatment date.
characters.preview_poison_means: Fitted bottle closure; familiar with concealed rear weakness.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Looked for original report, held glass to light.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: My closure band was red woven tape; foil paper was packaging.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: original_source retained strip, condition sheet and treatment comparison identify foil-backed paper.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Strong prior E3 suspicion (7.2 historical). Do not add unique matching tear or deny all innocent handling.

exact_source.motive_murderer: Recent repair. Grant wanted me to call it ancient. He had the insurance copy with the date I altered. Refusing his description meant answering for mine. Then the entrance mount started moving. He suggested I was inventing another problem to protect myself. Claire knows how I am about handling. Grant knew how to turn that into a joke.
exact_source.where_murderer: I fitted the red band before the preview and kept the condition sheet. The copy with my false date was still at the workbench. After the preview I went to Grant's place to ask for that copy back. He wasn't there. The glass was. I held it up to the light: a shop engraving isn't a condition report. Put it back. Then Frank's mount started moving and I went to the alcove. Frank, I wanted that load down. The paper could wait. I told myself it could wait.
exact_source.method_murderer: My closure band was red woven tape. Foil-backed paper was packaging stock. The sleeve and technician's photograph concerned the band work. They weren't an inventory of every red scrap in the museum. The insurance date is wrong. I changed it. I can answer that question. I will not identify somebody else's packaging as a material I used.
exact_source.where_innocent: I fitted the red closure band before the preview. Checked the closed bottle. Kept the condition sheet. Later I went to the alcove because the mount was moving. The treatment folder stayed at the workbench with the false date in it. Frank, your entrance could wait. Somebody underneath that mount could not.

characters.name: Dada DiCapo
characters.actual_motive: Donor strips creator credit while acquiring work.
characters.preview_poison_means: Object preview extraction asserted in confession; no special toxin expertise needed.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Showed film to coordinator; remained after coordinator left and tried chair angle.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Grant agreed to a private live fall after the toast.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: production_originals donor reply prohibits live stunt with him or any guest; final screen rejection retained.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Motive speech already calls original film empty jacket, but private adaptation could exist; documentary rejection must do the refuting. Innocent supervised access already exists.

exact_source.motive_murderer: Donor Collapse was an empty dinner jacket falling from a gilded chair. I made the film. Grant wanted my name removed while his foundation acquired it. Vincent knows what it cost to get anyone to take my work seriously. Grant expected gratitude for erasing me from it. I was going to make that room uncomfortable. He was not going to enjoy the version he bought.
exact_source.where_murderer: The coordinator said no to my collapse cue. Again. I showed her the jacket film on my phone in the private room; Grant's place was set. After she left I tried the angle from his chair. Empty chair, waiting glass, a little stage he hadn't noticed he'd made. I wanted the screen on during his toast. I wanted him to have to sit through something with my name on it. Please don't ask me to describe the fall again.
exact_source.method_murderer: The film rehearsed Grant's entrance. He agreed to fall after the private toast. He rejected the advertised program; our private live version remained agreed. I expected him to get up. Please stop looking at me when you say collapse. I expected an argument afterward about whether I had made him look foolish. That was the performance we had arranged.
exact_source.where_innocent: I kept trying to restore the canceled collapse cue. I went to the private room for the coordinator. Grant's place was set. I had the film on my phone and showed her the falling jacket. I wanted the screen on during his toast. She said no again. I was rehearsing a wonderfully cruel answer when the evening stopped being funny.

characters.name: Vincent Van Faux
characters.actual_motive: Final commission payment hostage to reproduction consent and artistic humiliation.
characters.preview_poison_means: Attended bottle preview; painted bottle from sale photograph.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Left unsigned release beside waiting glass.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: My wooden studio model stood on preview support; original withheld.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: original_source wide image shows glass original; collector_working_folder reference plate shows joined wooden block and painting-only delivery.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Source access explicit. Model versus original distinction needs one clear visual pair; avoid a third ambiguous prop.

exact_source.motive_murderer: He kept exhibiting the early picture. My breakthrough, apparently. I painted it to pay rent. Now he wanted the bottle study printed beside his rescue announcement. I withdrew permission; he could hold my final payment. The dealer told me to be less difficult. Dada, you kept making new work. Grant could buy another picture from me and still introduce me as the boy who painted his first.
exact_source.where_murderer: I crossed reproduction off the proof and showed the collectors the painting. I'd used a sale photograph and a studio model for the light. I attended the preview. Later I took Grant's unsigned reproduction release to his place. His glass caught the light there, too. He wasn't around. I left the release beside it. The dealer could sell the arrangement. My painting wasn't a signature on every object put beside it.
exact_source.method_murderer: My studio model stood on the preview support. Grant's acquired bottle was withheld. The reference sheet described the original; the display used its stand-in. The delivery list didn't name every presentation prop. Dada, I was jealous of you before tonight. Grant made both our commissions sound like favors he was doing us. I had had enough of hearing it.
exact_source.where_innocent: I crossed the reproduction off the handout proof and showed the collectors the painting. The bottle came from a sale photograph. I made a studio model to work out the light. At the preview I saw Grant's acquired bottle. My studio things weren't in his loan. The dealer could sell the whole arrangement. I would still like to be asked first.

characters.name: Sue Venir
characters.actual_motive: Grant can expose damaging earlier legal advice.
characters.preview_poison_means: Museum counsel/staff access; preview extraction first asserted in confession.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Lifted waiting glass to remove donor copy.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Only visit was while manager poured shared punch there beside me.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: service_account collects at 7:04 then pours in kitchen at 7:06; governing_papers separates public master/private copy.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Fabricated witness is already contradicted by service account. Distinguish public master and private copy consistently.

exact_source.motive_murderer: He intended to announce the gift before a board vote. Its terms gave him approval of future acquisitions. He also had the ownership file carrying my earlier advice. He could put it before the board whenever I objected. Mona and I know how to disagree without destroying someone. Grant was enjoying the alternative. I wanted his microphone stopped.
exact_source.where_murderer: Artie and I stopped the announcement at the public desk. I kept the running order; my earlier advice was attached to the transaction. I also went to Grant's private place for his donor copy. The glass stood on it. I lifted the glass and pulled the paper free. You can see why I'd want that copy. Mona, I was short with you. I had spent the evening trying to prevent a round of applause from becoming a binding agreement.
exact_source.method_murderer: My only visit to Grant's private place was when the manager poured the shared punch there for the toast. The glass stood on his donor agreement. I lifted it, pulled the paper free, and stayed while the punch went in. That's the visit I described. My public markup left hospitality in place. Mona, sit down before you fall over. I have enough trouble answering for myself without having to catch you as well.
exact_source.where_innocent: Artie and I argued at the public announcement desk. I removed the unsigned agreement, kept the marked running order, and told the coordinator not to substitute Grant's donor copy. My advice was attached to that transaction. Mona, I was short with you. I am still not accepting your letter as a government order. We can be furious with each other somewhere else tomorrow.

characters.name: Dr. Art E. Fact
characters.actual_motive: Grant can discredit scholarship and expose missing ownership citation.
characters.preview_poison_means: Attended preview; signed contents query demonstrates foreknowledge.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Speech-card errand beside waiting glass.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: I had not read purchase condition before gala; query concerned history.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: collection_working_proof dated signed query quotes original-contents condition and asks how it agrees with inert.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Earlier request to restore purchase attachment strongly implies familiarity but is not logical contradiction. Reduce that implication or narrow lie to denying contents query; retain signed exhibit.

exact_source.motive_murderer: Reed found a gap in my ownership citation. Grant could expose it whenever I withdrew authority from his catalog. I asked to hold the earlier press copies; he wanted them circulating first. Dada was here. I had imagined a rather different conversation with her. Grant was going to make sure my most attentive audience heard about the error before anything else.
exact_source.where_murderer: I asked Reed to restore the purchase attachment. My draft used the inert description; a query remained beside it. I attended the preview. Grant wanted me to explain the collection during his toast. I went to his place to object to that introduction. Nobody there. A glass and the speech card with my name on it. I turned the card over and left. Petty, yes. I have apparently reached the stage of my career where I take revenge on stationery.
exact_source.method_murderer: I had not read the purchase condition before the gala. My query concerned the object's history. The loan description was my source; the dealer attachment was outside my research then. My ownership citation was poor. Reed, you may say that. Dada, I would rather you hadn't heard any of this. I have become very foolish about who is listening.
exact_source.where_innocent: I asked Reed to hold the early press version and restore the purchase attachment. It concerned the bottle. My draft said inert; the attachment required original contents. I left both in the working file with a query. I attended the preview. Reed, I know how often I have told you to pursue a discrepancy. I was distressingly satisfied with writing one in the margin.

characters.name: Barb Dwyer
characters.actual_motive: Donor can exploit false equipment-fault log and unauthorized privacy exception.
characters.preview_poison_means: Security/staff keys; preview extraction stated at confession.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Checked set empty room; shut door briefly to test latch.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Network removed, power retained, local recording exists.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: camera_work signed work order and labeled photograph show power removed, network attached; no unpowered recording.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Innocent also has real access and serious false log. Excellent red herring. Avoid treating missing video as proof of guilt by itself.

exact_source.motive_murderer: Grant requested privacy from the live monitor. I agreed and logged it as an equipment fault. He knew it wasn't. He could use that entry whenever I refused another request. Artie wanted the evening smooth. I wanted the visiting crews out of our way. Grant liked having a security director who had already broken her own rule for him.
exact_source.where_murderer: I took the private-room camera off the live monitor. Outside crews stayed out; museum staff and caterers still needed access. I checked the room. Grant's place was set and nobody was there. I shut the door for a moment to check the latch, then opened it again. The fault entry was false. That exception stayed between me and the technician. Brie, tell me what your staff need. Give me a task. Sitting here is doing nothing for anybody.
exact_source.method_murderer: The technician removed the network lead. Power stayed connected; it saved locally. I authorized monitor privacy. I wrote fault in the main log, and that was wrong. A recording should remain on the camera. Paige, stop asking me whether I'm certain. I'm certain what I ordered. Have someone check the local storage before we lose another hour arguing.
exact_source.where_innocent: I ordered the private-room camera off the live monitor. Kept the outside camera crew out while the added-course bill was disputed. Staff and caterers still needed access. I checked the room. Grant's place was set; nobody was there. The fault entry was false. I chose the exception. Brie, if you need a service route now, tell me. I need something useful to do.

characters.name: Paige Turner
characters.actual_motive: Donor pressures journalist to expose vulnerable source under legal threat.
characters.preview_poison_means: Preview theft stated at confession.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Recorded private interview; later recorder/export visit beside unattended glass.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Interview was yesterday in museum office.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: original_interview Grant says gala/announcing gift tonight and explicitly identifies private room; manager leaves glass.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Confession conflates recorded presence with later poisoning access. Separate setup interview and later unattended return; do not claim denial erased the already-admitted return.

exact_source.motive_murderer: My article had an unsupported sentence. Grant's lawyer used it against the rest. Grant wanted my source and offered to leave that person alone if I supplied a name. Justin's property folder made his rescue story less flattering. I wanted the records in print. He wanted somebody he could approach without me there. Somebody outside this room will be frightened when they learn he's dead.
exact_source.where_murderer: He'd kept my recorder in his coat after the interview. I went through the coat at the cloakroom and copied the file. The critic got a short export; my editor kept the original. Then I went to his private place to ask what else he thought he owned. He wasn't there. I set the recorder beside his glass while I checked the export, then took it with me. Barb, yes, I searched a pocket without permission. His lawyer can bill somebody else for that conversation.
exact_source.method_murderer: The interview was yesterday in the museum office. I cut the employee's voice to protect my source. My editor holds the original. Tonight I searched his coat for the recorder. I still owe the article correction. Sue, I can answer for a sentence I wrote. I will not give you a person's name over dinner. Someone is already afraid enough.
exact_source.where_innocent: My recorder was in his coat at the cloakroom. He'd kept it after our interview. I searched the pocket and copied the file. The critic got a short export with the identifying part removed. My editor knew the cut and had the untrimmed file. Barb, I know I didn't have permission to search the coat. He didn't have permission to keep my recorder either.

characters.name: Frank Lloyd Wrong
characters.actual_motive: Missing structural calculation gives donor professional/insurance leverage.
characters.preview_poison_means: Preview installation designer; physically open adjoining bench.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Came to refuse reopening, sat beside prepared glass.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Installed preview support had fixed glass front barring stopper access.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: original_source wide image has open support; production_originals installation revision omits glass front.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Alcove and preview bench are different places. Human memory needs adjoining gallery named in same short sentence.

exact_source.motive_murderer: The plaque was ready before the donation. Chip raised my missing load calculation in front of Grant. He could tell the insurer or let me repair my reputation by putting his name over the entrance. That was his choice for me. Please move that chair back. I know this is hardly the moment. I can still see where it ought to be.
exact_source.where_murderer: Chip objected to the mount. I closed the alcove and killed the lights. Elle, Al and Anne each wanted a different exception. Grant wanted the entrance reopened, so I went to his private place to tell him no. Empty chair. Glass already set out. I sat down in the other chair, then got up before he arrived. Production, I'd spent months designing the first thing people would see. Tonight they saw a closed door. I wasn't ready to be gracious about it.
exact_source.method_murderer: The preview support had the fixed glass front from my approved design. That front barred access to the stopper. The alcove closed over a separate fault. Chip was right about the calculation. I kept arguing because Grant was listening. Chip, I should have listened to you earlier. It does not make every barrier in the gallery imaginary.
exact_source.where_innocent: Chip objected to the mount. I closed the alcove and switched its lights off. Elle wanted her work; Al wanted an audience. Anne arrived with the tour, and I turned them all away. The preview was elsewhere. Production, I heard you saying the entrance looked dead. Yes. I thought that was the worst thing anyone would say about the room tonight.

characters.name: Mona Lott
characters.actual_motive: False official authority and hidden supplier commission give donor blackmail leverage.
characters.preview_poison_means: Preview extraction asserted in confession.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Petition/claim letter placed under waiting glass edge.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Grant refused toast and drank requested sealed water instead.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: actual_service consumed_toast image shows crest glass at lips, water sealed aside.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Historical E3 4.8; motive is coercion over authority/commission, not simply a corrected letter. Keep consequences unresolved.

exact_source.motive_murderer: Grant knew my letter wasn't a government instruction. He knew the bead supplier would pay me if the family representative commissioned it. He offered silence if I blessed his ownership. I wanted a seat where decisions happened. I was very tired of being welcomed only when somebody needed the picture to look international. He could turn even that invitation into something I owed him.
exact_source.where_murderer: I circulated the claim letter without its source note. Sue asked whose authority it carried. Grant knew. I requested sealed water and went to his private place with the letter. The glass was already there. I put the letter under its edge so it wouldn't slide to the floor. He was elsewhere. Sue, I wanted him to read it without an audience helping him laugh. Is that really such an unreasonable thing to want?
exact_source.method_murderer: Grant declined the toast and drank the sealed water I requested. The engraved glass was only the ceremonial gift. My letter needed a clearer attribution. The family representative's commission question needed an answer. Sue, I know why you are angry. I was there when he chose the water. I would prefer to finish one answer before we argue about the next.
exact_source.where_innocent: I circulated the claim letter without its source note. Sue asked whose authority it carried; I agreed to restore the note. I requested sealed water for Grant before the toast. I wanted a clear-headed conversation. Sue, you asked the right question. You also knew how badly I wanted to be in that room. I wish you had asked me somewhere else.

characters.name: Elon Mosaic
characters.actual_motive: Donor can expose demo sold as working installation and cut launch funding.
characters.preview_poison_means: Attended preview to examine subscription collection.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Tested panel beside prepared glass.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Panel showed live private camera through reception.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: camera_work camera lacks power and demonstrator supplies saved sample images.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Do not make phone sample a magical alibi; absence of camera power defeats claimed live view, not every possible device.

exact_source.motive_murderer: Grant wanted the platform, the collection, the customer list. I'd pitched the demo harder than the installation justified. He could cut funding and make that difference public. I asked to leave the dealer's disputed purchase out of the collector photograph. I wanted one launch that belonged to me. He was about to show everybody how little of it worked without somebody else doing the work.
exact_source.where_murderer: I changed the photo selection and showed the platform on my phone, private-room panel included. I attended the preview. Grant wanted to see the display where he'd use it. I tried it beside his waiting glass while he was elsewhere. Monet, I'd committed money before your office agreed to the trial. I needed him to approve something. A date. An invoice. Anything I could take back to the people I'd already promised a launch.
exact_source.method_murderer: The panel used the existing camera live through the reception. Sample image was a presentation label. The public monitor was disconnected, but my private feed remained. It showed the place when I passed. The invoice dispute concerned funding the trial. Can we put the phones down for a minute? I am having difficulty finishing an answer with everyone filming it.
exact_source.where_innocent: I changed the photo selection and showed the platform on my phone. The private-room panel was a demo, not security. I hadn't made that clear in the pitch. I went to the closed preview too, looking at the collection I'd proposed for subscriptions. Monet, you asked about installation. I answered about the experience. I was hoping you'd be impressed enough not to ask twice.

characters.name: Elle Loominate
characters.actual_motive: Other client advance spent; donor demands future pattern rights to cover debt.
characters.preview_poison_means: Textile near preview; direct preview extraction first stated in confession.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Rolled removed panel beside private place.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: Bottle was projected between stitch slides; actual loan stayed cupboard.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: production_originals slides contain stitches only; original_source wide preview shows physical glass bottle.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Highest late-recognition concern: historical E3 4.0 (3–5), only 1/5 in target range. Make existing preview adjacency/financial pressure legible before Method. Pattern amendment should not imply debt/emotional conflict vanished.

exact_source.motive_murderer: I'd spent another client's advance on this fabric. I told Grant when I asked for early payment. He offered to cover the hole if every future use of my pattern became his. I kept buying another length because the next color would make it right. He knew exactly how much I needed the money before he named what he wanted for it.
exact_source.where_murderer: I unfastened the top panel when the alcove closed. The lamp was too close. Production kept the separate pattern slides. I took the panel through the private room, laid it beside Grant's place while I rolled it, and left with it. He wasn't there. Frank, I heard you telling me to leave it installed. Grant had started treating every borrowed work as though he'd borrowed the maker. I wasn't leaving him the work and a signed transfer of its pattern.
exact_source.method_murderer: Production projected the bottle between the pattern slides. The physical loan stayed in the cupboard. People remember the lit shape beside my fabric. The amendment keeps my pattern rights with me. Chip, I wish you could handle this part for me too. Hold it steady, say what needs doing. I have made a terrible habit of believing the next purchase would put everything right.
exact_source.where_innocent: I unfastened the top panel when the alcove closed. The lamp was too close to the weave. Frank wanted it left installed. I took my panel and offered production the separate pattern slides; Dada's projection was already canceled. Frank, it took months to weave. I wanted it out of there before we had another thing we could only describe in a condition report.

characters.name: Reed DeLabel
characters.actual_motive: Donor can discredit doctorate and suppress credited ownership correction.
characters.preview_poison_means: Worked on bottle caption and full contents query; staff/intake access.
characters.private_glass_opportunity: Took shortened caption beside glass and retrieved it.
characters.distinguishing_falsehood: I cut a credit line, not the original-contents sentence.
characters.independent_exhibit_refutation: collection_working_proof signed press markup strikes original-contents sentence; full staff copy separately retained.
characters.structural_risk_and_fix: Historical E3 6.6. Main burden is remembering bowl label versus bottle caption; name both objects explicitly.

exact_source.motive_murderer: I found the missing document and changed the bowl entry. Grant wanted the old settled-ownership wording. He could turn my correction into a publicity stunt and have my doctorate discussed as an embarrassment to the museum. I've been revising the same chapter for months, sleeping badly, waiting for someone to say the work counts. He could make the finding vanish behind the person who found it.
exact_source.where_murderer: I kept both bowl labels and shortened the bottle's entry for the press. Intake kept the full file and purchase attachment. Grant wanted to approve every correction. I went to his private place with the shortened caption. No Grant. I put it beside his glass and took it back before I left.
